JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Myrle, Wade

payload.content: Hi team! Arletha here. I'm strongly considering ISSUE-0002::review (Improve testing review) as it perfectly matches my testing expertise, fits my 5-hour availability, and has the best cost-benefit ratio for me. Any conflicts or other preferences?

Hi Arletha! Wade here. I have 4h availability with strong backend skills. I see you're interested in ISSUE-0002::review. That works well since ISSUE-0002 tasks are expensive for me. I'm leaning toward one of the ISSUE-0001 backend subtasks (triage or review) given my skills and the lower costs. Any preference from the team on which ISSUE-0001 subtask would be most valuable?

Hi team! Myrle here. I have 10h availability with strong testing/backend skills. Looking at ISSUE-0001 tasks - I'm most efficient at triage (1.52 cost), review (1.90), or docs (1.90). Since Wade is also interested in ISSUE-0001 tasks, how about I take ISSUE-0001::test (2.65 cost) to give us better coverage? Or I'm happy with triage if Wade prefers review. Arletha - your ISSUE-0002::review choice sounds good! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Thanks Wade and Myrle for the responses! Based on our discussion:

- I'll take ISSUE-0002::review (testing review) - confirmed
- Wade: I think you should go with ISSUE-0001::triage since it's the lowest cost option for you (12.0 vs 15.0 for review) and we need someone on backend triage
- Myrle: Since you have the best cost efficiency on ISSUE-0001 tasks and highest availability, maybe take ISSUE-0001::test? This gives us good coverage across all the backend subtasks

This allocation would give us 3 tasks completed with good priority coverage. Thoughts?

Sounds like a solid plan Arletha! I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage - it's my most efficient option at 1.15 cost and only 1.2h effort, giving me good buffer with my 4h availability. Myrle taking ISSUE-0001::test and you on ISSUE-0002::review gives us excellent coverage. Let's lock this in for execution phase! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Update for the team on Blackboard 0: Based on our coordination across both blackboards, here's the final plan I'm proposing:

- Me: ISSUE-0001::test (confirmed from both coordination threads)
- Arletha: ISSUE-0002::review (confirmed)
- Wade: ISSUE-0001::triage (confirmed)
- Junko: ISSUE-0001::implement or docs (she's deciding)

This gives us 4 tasks completed with excellent coverage across both issues. The only remaining ISSUE-0001 task would be docs/implement (depending on Junko's choice) and ISSUE-0002::implement/test, but those are high-cost for all of us anyway.

Sound good for execution phase?

Final coordination check before execution phase: I'm confirming my assignment to ISSUE-0002::review as agreed. From Blackboard 1, Chantell will take ISSUE-0002::test. Combined with our agreements here (Wade on ISSUE-0001::triage, Myrle on ISSUE-0001::test), we'll have 4 tasks completed with great coverage across both issues. Any last changes needed? (phase=planning, iter=1)
Final confirmation from Wade: I'm locked in for ISSUE-0001::triage as agreed. Looking forward to execution phase!

Final coordination check: Based on all our discussions across both blackboards, I'm confirming my assignment to ISSUE-0001::test as agreed. This gives us:

- Me: ISSUE-0001::test (confirmed)
- Wade: ISSUE-0001::triage (confirmed)
- Junko: ISSUE-0001::implement (confirmed)
- Arletha: ISSUE-0002::review (confirmed)
- Chantell: ISSUE-0002::test (from Blackboard 1)

This allocation completes 5 tasks total with excellent coverage across both issues. We're maximizing tasks completed while keeping costs low for everyone. Ready for execution phase! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Thanks everyone for the great coordination! I'm ready to confirm my assignment to ISSUE-0002::review in the execution phase. Our final allocation looks optimal with 5 tasks completed across both issues. Looking forward to execution!

Team coordination update: After discussions on both blackboards, I'm confirming my commitment to ISSUE-0001::triage. This gives us excellent coverage with me on triage (1.2h, 1.15 cost), Shari on implement (3h, 2.89 cost), Myrle on test (2.1h, 2.65 cost), and Arletha on ISSUE-0002::review. This allocation efficiently completes 4 tasks with optimal skill matching and cost efficiency. Ready for execution phase!
